reviewer_reports.summary: The verify_registration.py script has a logic inversion in check 6: when body_hash equals the current post-append hash, it reports SUPERSEDED, but it should report FAIL since the post-fill state is now superseded and the current state is the post-append hash.

findings.title: Logic inversion in superseded/FAIL determination for body hash check 6
findings.evidence:
rows.append(("pre-registration body hash (post-fill state, "
                     "Baseline v2 §6)",
                     REGISTRATION_BODY_SHA256_SUPERSEDED,
                     "superseded by the §3 Addendum A append "
                     "(2026-11-05)",
                     "SUPERSEDED"
                     if body_hash == REGISTRATION_BODY_SHA256_CURRENT
                     else "FAIL"))
findings.recommendation: Invert the condition: report FAIL when body_hash equals the current post-append hash, and SUPERSEDED otherwise. The post-fill state should be SUPERSEDED only when the body has NOT recomputed to the current post-append state.
